question: The term A of the Van Deemter equation, known as "multiple paths", "swirl diffusion" or "Eddy diffusion":

options.opa: It increases as the particle size of the stationary phase increases.
options.opb: It decreases with increasing particle size of the stationary phase.
options.opc: It is greater in the open capillary columns than in the filling columns.
options.opd: Increases with increasing the speed of the mobile phase.
options.ope: It decreases as the speed of the mobile phase increases.
